title: Global Small Marine Engines Market Size To Worth USD 13.60 Billion By 2033 l CAGR Of 5.37% - GlobeNewswire
description: The global small marine engines market is expected to grow from USD 8.06 billion in 2023 to USD 13.60 billion by 2033, driven by the increasing demand for recreational boats and fuel-efficient outboard engines.

title: Freedom Boat Club Acquires South Florida Franchise Operation and Territory, Accelerating Growth and Expanding its Southeast Florida Corporate Territory
description: Freedom Boat Club, a Brunswick Corporation brand, has acquired the South Florida franchise operations and territory, adding 13 corporate locations and expanding its presence in the Southeast Florida region. This acquisition aims to leverage synergies and operational efficiencies within the Brunswick family of brands.

title: BC's Freedom Boat Club Expands South Florida Operations
description: Brunswick Corporation's Freedom Boat Club acquired the South Florida franchise operations, adding 13 corporate locations and accelerating the company's growth in the region. The acquisition enhances operational efficiencies and provides a key opportunity to expand in a year-round boating market.

title: Brunswick Corporation’s award-winning 2024 Cannes Yachting Festival includes new product announcements and leading market share
description: Brunswick Corporation showcased its industry-leading brands, including Mercury Marine, Navico Group, and its boat brands, at the 2024 Cannes Yachting Festival. The company reported strong market share, new product introductions, and industry accolades.

title: Brunswick Corporation to announce 2024 Third Quarter Earnings on October 24
description: Brunswick Corporation, a leading marine recreation company, will announce its 2024 third quarter earnings on October 24, 2024, and host a conference call to discuss the results.

title: Brunswick Corporation Announces Quarterly Dividend
description: Brunswick Corporation announced a quarterly dividend of $0.42 per share, payable on December 13, 2024, to shareholders of record on November 20, 2024.

title: Brunswick Corporation Named One of the ‘World’s Top Companies for Women 2024’ by Forbes
description: Brunswick Corporation, the world's largest recreational marine technology company, has been named one of the 'World's Top Companies for Women' by Forbes for its leadership in supporting women in the workplace. Women represent a growing percentage of Brunswick's total employee base, including half of the division presidents, as well as many key brand and functional leaders across the Company.
